summary: Reviewed mcp-server/src/schema/knowledge.ts and mcp-server/tests/schema/knowledge.test.ts line-by-line against all four review dimensions.
InsightScope enum change is correct: ['global', 'repository'] is clean, 'project' fully removed, dual type/value export pattern is idiomatic Zod TypeScript.

PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX is unchanged. Updated JSDoc accurately reflects dual usage for repository_name and origin_plan. Deferral of rename (PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX → SLUG_REGEX) is correct — exporting a renamed constant is a breaking change for consumers.

InsightSchema: repository_name and origin_plan both use .string().regex(PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX).optional() — correct. project_slug field is absent — confirmed. Field ordering is logical (scope before context fields).

Architectural decision to delegate scope='repository' → repository_name co-constraint to the storage layer is sound: keeps the schema context-free and composable, avoids discriminated-union complexity that would hinder partial-update patterns.
JSDoc comments on all fields are precise, internally consistent, and accurately describe storage-layer ownership of the co-constraint.

Test file: all 5 AC tests are present and well-targeted. it.each pattern for required-field rejection is clean and scalable. Fixtures are minimal and composable. No dead test code. Zero blocking findings. No Fix-Forward changes required.

comments.note: The architectural decision to keep the co-constraint (scope='repository' requires repository_name) out of the Zod schema and delegate it to the storage layer is correct and forward-looking. Encoding it as a discriminated union would complicate partial-update patterns and make the schema harder to compose in future WPs. This is a gold-nugget pattern worth preserving across the codebase.

[documentation-forward] The origin_plan field is semantically distinct from source (a URL/reference link vs. a planning artefact slug) and this distinction is only explained in the InsightSchema JSDoc. Any higher-level architecture or API reference document should call out origin_plan explicitly, contrasting it with source, so consumers understand when to use each.
No blocking issues, no Fix-Forward changes required. Code is clean, consistent, and well-commented.
